---
title: "Roles and responsibilities"
description: "Analyst, critical friend, commissioner and Analysis Senior Responsible Officer. A page each, and the parts that belong to all four."
---

Four roles run through the five phases. You hold one of them on one piece of work, and you might
hold a different one on the next. Each has a page of its own: what it owns, what is yours in each
phase, and where to go next.

What is on this page is the part that belongs to no single role: the other names you will meet
these roles under, where a disagreement goes, and who holds the organisational roles.

## The same role under another name

You will meet these roles under other titles. Where one of them is in front of you, read it as the
role in this playbook.

| In this playbook | Also called |
|------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Critical friend** | *Analytical assurer*, which is the standards' term for the same person: GovS 010 defines it at 4.4.6 and the AQuA Book at 5.1 |
| **Analysis Senior Responsible Officer** | *Model Senior Responsible Officer* in the Business Critical documentation, *Senior Responsible Owner* in the draft Analytical Governance and Quality Assurance Policy, and *approver* in the AQuA Book |

## When you disagree

Disagreement is a healthy sign, and the routes are short.

| Disagreement | Goes to |
|---|---|
| The assurance level | The Analytical Quality and Assurance Lead |
| Whether the analysis is Business Critical | The commissioner decides. Escalate to the Analytical Quality and Assurance Lead if unresolved |
| Whether the analysis is fit for purpose | The critical friend advises. Unresolved, escalate to the Head of Profession |
| Whether there is enough time for the assurance required | The commissioner, then the Analytical Quality and Assurance Lead |
| An ethical concern | The commissioner decides, because they own the decision. Unresolved, the Analytical Quality and Assurance Lead, or the Head of Profession where the output is an official statistic |

**Deadline pressure is not resolved by lowering the assurance level.** It is resolved by narrowing
the question, or by saying plainly what assurance was not done.

{{< include /guidance/_partials/diagram-disagreement-routes.qmd >}}

## Who holds the organisational roles

The four roles above are the ones you hold on a piece of work. Separately, GovS 010 asks NHSBSA to
appoint a senior officer accountable for analysis as an activity, and to define analytical roles
in its governance framework and assign them to people who can hold them. Those are organisational
arrangements rather than a role on any one output.

Who holds the Analytical Quality and Assurance Lead, the Head of Profession for Statistics and
the senior officer accountable for analysis is recorded in NHSBSA's governance and management
framework, not here. A change of post holder is then not a change to this playbook.
If you need one of them and do not know who they are, see
[who to ask](../09-resources/r3-who-to-ask.qmd).
